#Setup

```{r wd and packages}
}
```

#1) 16s Relative abundance calculation and plotting
```{r 1.a Read in the data}
data <- read_csv('feature_table_16S.csv')
taxonomy_16s <- read_tsv('taxonomy_16S.tsv')
metadata <- read_csv('metadata_IFGvSBC') 
```

```{r 1.b determine sequence count cuttoff}
#data %>%
#  select(-ASV_ID) %>%
#  colSums() %>%
#  data.frame(counts = .) %>%
#  ggplot(aes(x = counts)) +
#  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
#  geom_vline(xintercept = 4000, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +  # optional cutoff line
#  labs(x = "Sample Read Count", y = "Number of Samples")
```

```{r 1.c dataframe setup for NMDS}
#get the samples less than a threshold of seq count
##set min-sequence count
count_cutoff <- 4000

drop_samples <- data %>%
  select(-ASV_ID) %>% #remove ASV-ID column as it is non-numeric
  colSums() %>% #total counts per sample
  .[. < count_cutoff] %>% #filtering the named numbers by cuttoff
  names() #pulling the names (sample_IDs) of numbers below the threshold set earlier
```

```{r 1.d calcuate relative abundance}
all.16 <- data %>%
  left_join(taxonomy_16s) %>%
  select(-ASV_ID, -starts_with(c("Ext","PCR")), -any_of(drop_samples))  %>% #with taxonomy merged 
  pivot_longer(-colnames(taxonomy_16s)[2:8], names_to = "Sample", values_to = "count")  %>% #pivot count columns longer
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Class, Sample) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(collapse = sum(count)) %>% #collapse duplicates per sample
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(abund = 100*collapse/sum(collapse)) %>% #calculate relative abundance by sample /  column
  left_join(metadata) %>%
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Class, Watershed, IFG_SBC) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(relAbund =  mean(abund)) %>% #Average relative abundance across field reps
  mutate(Class = case_when(
  is.na(Class) & is.na(Phylum) ~ "Other",
  is.na(Class) ~ Phylum,
  TRUE ~ Class)) %>%
  mutate(
    Class = if_else(
      Class %in% (
        group_by(., Class) %>%
          summarise(total = sum(relAbund, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          arrange(desc(total)) %>%
          slice_head(n = 12) %>%
          pull(Class)
      ),
      Class,
      "Other")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(Class, Watershed, IFG_SBC, fill = list(relAbund = 0)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r}
color.16 <- c('#004586FF','#FF420EFF', '#FFD320FF', '#579D1CFF', '#7E0021FF', '#83CAFFFF', '#314004FF', '#0084D1FF', '#4B1F6FFF', '#C5000BFF','#FF950EFF', '#666666')

all.16.bar <- ggplot(all.16, aes(fill=Class, y=relAbund, x=IFG_SBC))+
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = color.16) +
  facet_grid(~Watershed)+
  #scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 0), labels = c("Rock", "Substrate")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Average Relative Abundance %") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = "NA",
                                    linewidth = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size=8),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0.45, 'pt'),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank())

#all.16.bar
```

#2) 18s Relative abundance calculation and plotting
```{r 2.a read in data}
data.18 <- read_csv('feature_table_18s.csv')
taxonomy.18 <- read_csv('taxonomy_18S.csv')
```

```{r 2.b pull samples and taxa to drop}
non.protist <- taxonomy.18 %>%
  filter(Phylum == 'p__Vertebrata' | Class %in% c("c__Insecta", "c__Arachnida") | Domain %in% c("Unassigned", "d__Bacteria", "d__Archaea")) %>%
  pull(ASV_ID)

#get the samples less than a threshold of seq count
##set min-sequence count
count_cutoff <- 10000

drop_samples.18 <- data.18 %>%
  select(-ASV_ID) %>% #remove ASV-ID column as it is non-numeric
  colSums() %>% #total counts per sample
  .[. < count_cutoff] %>% #filtering the named numbers by cuttoff
  names() #pulling the names (sample_IDs) of numbers below the threshold set earlier
```

```{r 2.c calculate relative abundance}
all.18 <- data.18 %>%
  left_join(taxonomy.18) %>%
  filter(!ASV_ID %in% non.protist) %>%
  select(-ASV_ID, -starts_with(c("Ext","PCR")), -any_of(drop_samples.18))  %>% #drop asv-id now that taxonomy has been merged, 
  pivot_longer(-colnames(taxonomy.18)[2:8], names_to = "Sample", values_to = "count")  %>% #pivot count columns longer
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Sample) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(collapse = sum(count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(abund = 100*collapse/sum(collapse)) %>% #calculate relative abundance by sample /  column
  left_join(metadata) %>%
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Watershed, IFG_SBC) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(relAbund =  mean(abund)) %>% #Average relative abundance across field reps
  mutate(Phylum = case_when(
  #is.na(Class) & is.na(Phylum) ~ "Other",
  is.na(Phylum) ~ "Other",
  TRUE ~ Phylum)) %>%
  mutate(
    Phylum = if_else(
      Phylum %in% (
        group_by(., Phylum) %>%
          summarise(total = sum(relAbund, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          arrange(desc(total)) %>%
          slice_head(n = 12) %>%
          pull(Phylum)
      ),
      Phylum,
      "Other")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(Phylum, Watershed, IFG_SBC, fill = list(relAbund = 0)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

```{r order the taxa and save the color ramp}
all.18$Phylum <- factor(all.18$Phylum, levels = c(
"p__Amoebozoa",
"p__Apicomplexa",
"p__Ascomycota",
"p__Basidiomycota",
"p__Cercozoa",
"p__Chytridiomycota",
"p__Ciliophora",
"p__Diatomea",
"p__Ochrophyta",
"p__Chlorophyta",
"p__Florideophycidae",
"Other"))

color.18 <- c('#004586FF','#FF420EFF', '#FFD320FF', '#579D1CFF', '#7E0021FF', '#83CAFFFF', '#4B1F6FFF',
              "#B88244FF", #Diatomea
              "#D1B000", #Ochrophyta
              "darkgreen",#Chlorophyta
              "darkred", #Florideophycidae
              '#666666') #the rest of em
```

```{r}
all.18.bar <- ggplot(all.18, aes(fill=Phylum, y=relAbund, x=IFG_SBC))+
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = color.18) +
  facet_grid(~Watershed)+
  #scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 0), labels = c("Rock", "Substrate")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Average Relative Abundance %") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = "NA",
                                    linewidth = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size=8),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0.45, 'pt'),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank())

all.18.bar
```

#3C ombine the two plots
```{r 3.a combine the plots}
bar.2 <- ggarrange(all.16.bar, all.18.bar,
                    align = 'v',
                    ncol = 1, nrow = 2,
                    labels = 'auto')
```

```{r 3.b save the final plot}
ggsave(
  filename="Algae_Bar_Supplement.pdf",
  plot = bar.2,
  dpi = 600,
  width = 160,
  height = 240,
  units = 'mm'
)
```
